title: Emit an operation
statement: Given an input index $i_0$, an operation $o$ (conjunction or disjunction), a line index $\ell$, and a list of rails, return a list of statements and an output rail. For an empty list, emit $o$ applied dually to $x_{i_0}$ and $\neg x_{i_0}$, followed by $o$ applied to those operands, and return the pair of lines $\ell,\ell+1$. For a singleton list, emit no statements and return its rail. For a list with at least two rails, emit $o$ on the first components of the first two rails and its dual on their second components, then return the pair of lines $\ell,\ell+1$.
hypotheses_covered: An operation that is conjunction or disjunction
